Zoe: Quick shoutout — Kai and Rita swooped in for the last-minute investor demo and smoothed the latency spikes. absolute legends. :star2: :clap:
Kai: thanks! Rita found a weird fallback that was thrashing the cache. patch + config tweak and the traces looked clean.
Rita: yup, added a guard on the fallback path. noted the fix in the deploy notes.
Zoe: Sending virtual samosas and high fives. also pinging People Ops to add a shoutout. :samosa: :raised_hands:
people-ops: Adding a kudos badge to Kai and Rita for "Demo Heroics". Expect an email with details. :tada:
Kai: also huge thanks to the support team for staying on the line. made the rollback plan calm and quick.
Rita: i'll drop a short snippet in the runbook under "fallback guards":
```
# fallback guard: ensure response size < 1MB before hitting backup
if resp.size > 1_000_000:
  log.warning("skipping fallback due to large response")
  return original_response
```
Zoe: GIF incoming: https://giphy.com/gifs/high-five-teamwork-3oEduQAsYcJKQH2XsI (high five)
ops-bot: Created follow-up ticket "document-fallback-guard" assigned to Rita, due in 4 days. (https://tracker.redwood/issue/5555)
Kai: snacks at next all-hands pls. :)
